from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document from the collection, capturing details needed to determine if it matches the target crime."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal')")
    charge_or_cause: str = Field(description="The specific legal charge or cause of action identified (e.g., '失火罪', '走私罪')")
    legal_category: str | None = Field(description="Explicit legal category or chapter mentioned in the text (e.g., '危害公共安全罪'), if stated")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Judgment]
